title: Fly-by-Code: Embodied Coding Agents for Aerial Manipulation with Active Visual and Physical Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.12549v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied coding agents construct robot policies from natural-language instructions by generating executable programs and refining them from execution feedback. This refinement assumes that execution feedback reveals whether the task succeeded and, after a failure, provides sufficient evidence to guide program revision. Aerial manipulation violates this assumption in two ways. Payload constraints restrict onboard camera coverage and leave task-critical outcomes outside the robot's view (partial observability), while strong dynamic coupling and limited control margins make physical interactions fragile (limited interaction robustness) and leave failure causes unresolved. Re-examining the same feedback cannot recover observations that were never collected or separate failure causes that the available evidence does not distinguish. To acquire this missing evidence, we introduce Active Feedback (AF), an active "View and Probe" framework. Wh

translated_title: Fly-by-Code（代码飞行）：基于主动视觉与物理反馈的空中操作具身编码智能体
translated_abstract: 具身编码智能体通过生成可执行程序并根据执行反馈对其进行改进，从而从自然语言指令构建机器人策略。这种改进过程假设执行反馈能够揭示任务是否成功，并且在任务失败后能提供足够的证据来指导程序修订。空中操作在两个方面违背了这一假设：载荷约束限制了机载相机的覆盖范围，使任务关键结果处于机器人视野之外（部分可观测性）；同时强烈的动态耦合和有限的控制裕度使物理交互变得脆弱（交互鲁棒性受限），导致失败原因难以确定。重新检查相同的反馈既无法恢复从未收集到的观测数据，也无法区分现有证据无法区分的失败原因。为了获取这些缺失的证据，我们引入了主动反馈，一个主动的“观察与探测”框架。……
tldr: 该论文提出主动反馈框架，通过主动“观察与探测”获取缺失的视觉和物理证据，解决了空中操作中部分可观测性和交互鲁棒性受限导致失败原因无法诊断的问题，从而支持具身编码智能体有效地改进程序策略。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Active Feedback (AF), an active "View and Probe" framework that actively acquires missing visual and physical evidence to overcome partial observability and limited interaction robustness in aerial manipulation, enabling embodied coding agents to effectively refine their program-based policies.
